title: Application to approve co-op housing project in Manhattanville
summary: Resolution approving an Urban Development Action Area Project for four buildings at 48-50 Convent Avenue, 453-455 West 125th Street and 12-14 Old Broadway in Manhattan's Community District 9. The project, under HPD's Affordable Neighborhood Cooperative Program, would rehabilitate the buildings into about 75 affordable cooperative units. Occupied apartments would be sold to existing tenants for $2,500 each, with vacant units priced for households earning up to 120% of area median income.
